notes: The greatest flavor I have ever tried. Once in a lifetime opportunity. Would give up many things to experience again.
body:
I remember watching Steve-O from tales from the trip describe one beloved salvia or acid experience he kept trying to recreate but never could do so. This drink is that moment for me. The sweetness combined with the sour that takes over is a flavor storm I could never recreate. I'm writing this purely from memory so I'll do my best.

Overall taste: When chilled, it's sweet followed by a tropical skittles flavor that leaves very little dry aftertaste. Each sip is like a new flavor profile of skittles, with a slight sourness buildup. It's chuggable, as it's not too overwheming, and quite fun. It's quite nice chilled or when it loses it's chill a bit, when it tastes a bit less sweet but nothing overpowering. The best way I can describe this is cosmic stardust, with the skittle taste that's far superior, heterogeneous in every sip, and the tropical sweet undertones of Hawaiian Shaved Ice. It doesn't do it justice, but it's the best description I remember.

Overall experience: I think about this drink every week. Perfect amount of sour and carbonation hit. Please contact me if you have any spares.
name: Electric Vibe — Tropical Freeze
